fields.FIR_Description: A online complaint dated 2025-10-10 states that an advance of Rs. 4,00,000 was collected from the complainant for an event catering booking near Nallur Park Main Street, after which the person became unreachable, on 2025-10-08 at roughly 15:15. Geetha Kumari submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000202. An unidentified associate was also mentioned by the complainant. A person named Nandha Karuppasamy, associated with the number 9000000113, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Advance allegedly collected for a service that was not provided.
fields.Keywords: advance payment, cheating, afternoon, suspect, mobile number, digital document, main street
